chapter_title: Concerning the Man who is ugly in his Body, [but]
spiritual_reading:
Distinct and precious truths do not arise everywhere within the general field of external knowledge, nor do they take form from that field taken as a whole. They are brought forth only in particular states within that external domain where reception has been prepared.

In those states an inflow of love from what is higher kindles and is directed downward into lower degrees. As it descends, truth is set into an active outward form, first appearing as a stirred and unstable mixture in the outermost level. Then a gentle inflow of truth from above is introduced, and the first effect is not deep penetration into the lowest and most general level, but a remaining in what is more external and accessible, where it can be received without being swallowed up by merely general and undistinguished knowledge.

This gentle inflow is taken up by purer truths already present in the recipient, and they unite. Because it does not sink into the lowest obscurity of mere generals, it can be held in the outer plane where it is first received. From that reception an initial containing form is produced, and within that containing form the inflowing truth is held and protected while it is being purified and fixed.

When the inflowing truth is not received as one coherent reception but is divided into many small receptions, the result is not one complete precious truth but many lesser ones. Each reception is formed according to its measure: in one case a conjunction of will and understanding is achieved; in another case a full progression of degrees is achieved; in another case only a sufficient fullness for use is achieved; and in others more or less than these, according to the state of conjunction possible at the time.

But when a coherent reception is given and the containing form holds it without loss, a single precious truth is perfected in value according to the completeness of its conjunction. And if separate small receptions are given time to adhere and be mingled before any part escapes into dispersal, then even from what began divided a larger and more valued precious truth can be formed, because the inflowing truths are brought into unity within the containing form before they are scattered into mere particulars.

Consider, then, the manner in which precious truths are formed in the external domain: a truth descending from above is first received in an unstable outer form; from that first reception a containing form is produced; and that outer instability itself arises from the change and agitation of the external mind as higher influx enters and begins to order it.

As soon as such states are recognized by those who are in the work of recovery, they are moved by a directed influx toward those prepared states. They descend into the more external and obscure levels where such goods and truths have been hidden, and they raise them up into clearer light. Each one brings forth according to the portion of use and conjunction allotted to his function.

What is taken back from those external and obscured levels is like the descending truth that became receivable; those who are sent to recover are like those who search and draw it up. Those who then distribute are the enlighteners who provide discernment; and those who finally receive into higher order are the communities of higher greatness.

For all who rise within the natural life of humanity and are set free are brought back into the higher communities of light. There, a state of rest is formed for them, within the higher order of greatness.

fills.notes: Pearls form only where a specific active cause is present; correspondentially, distinct truths arise only where an inflow has prepared a particular state, not from the sea in general.
Needed to link: “that sea, in which the pearls shall be formed in this …” i.e., in this particular place or region.
The logic contrasts the whole sea with particular loci; correspondentially, the ‘external field’ vs prepared ‘states’ within it.
What the sea ‘shall’ do here is to receive the descending fire and produce foam; the external mind receives influx in ultimates.
The fire ‘blazes above and comes down’—the required direction of influx (higher to lower) in the substrate cosmology.
Balances the descent clause and keeps the inside-to-outside influx sequence.
Bridges: “drop of water that flows … down in rainwater … is the water …”
Fits: “is the water … comes down first … foam” matching the sequence: descent → first effect (foam).
Supports the process chain: descent first, then becoming foam, then coming down toward sweet waters.
Links foam’s movement to its destination (sweet waters), matching the spiritual sense: not to the depths but to accessible externals.
Construes “the sweet waters … the waters” as a distinction of purer vs general waters: sweet waters are ‘above’ the common waters in worth/order.
Required verb: “shall come down to the sweet waters”.
Keeps plural subject for the droplets/foam elements: they come and are received/absorbed.
They are absorbed and combined with what is already sweet/pure; correspondentially, higher truth conjoins with purer truths already present.
Opposes “depths of the sea”; spiritually, the inflow does not sink into mere generals but stays in the outer accessible plane.
Explains why it floated and why formation occurs at the surface: reception is possible only in that external plane.
Links: “shall be formed from this wholesome drop”.
The wholesome drop is specified as sweet water; the pearl is fixed within the shell by that sweet reception.
Completes “pearl … itself” (pearl becomes a pearl itself), emphasizing completion of the formed truth.
Fits: “drop of rainwater upon the waters”.
Introduces the twofold water source in the narrative: rainwater and sweet water, matching the spiritual pairing of descending influx and prior purified truths.
Introduces the causal: “it not being whole, because it breaks…”
Marks repetition: the dispersed droplets can ‘again’ become a sweet drop, i.e., be re-collected into unity.
The shell’s function is containment and protection; it ‘receives’ the adhering droplets before dispersal.
Direct object of the breaking/scattering clause.
The containing form is the decisive agent in the paragraph’s logic.
Correspondentially, truths are held and fixed within a containing form; this is the condition for a ‘great kind’.
Completes “in a great kind …”: a great kind of pearl, i.e., a more valued formed truth.
Matches the spiritual sense: given time to adhere before any part escapes into dispersal.
Carries the closing: waters form them and they are perfected “in a great, valued commodity.”
Oldest-layer register avoids doubled emphatic self-reference; simple impersonal teacher-voice suffices here.
Foam arises from transformation and agitation of the sea; spiritually, outer instability arises from change/agitation in the external mind as influx begins to order it.
Pearl divers recognize the state when pearls ‘rise’ or become available; correspondentially, workers recognize prepared states when truths are ready to be raised.
They begin the work once the state is known; corresponds to being moved by directed influx toward prepared states.
Completes “they go down”.
Completes “For all the souls …”

assessment: Most gaps can be restored at the level of process-logic (influx from above, first foam, retention near the surface, conjunction within a containing shell, multiplication when reception is divided, perfection when held together). Where the surviving English is already far from the underlying Coptic word-order, several short connectors remain tentative; but the macro-sequence and key substrate terms (inflow from above, sweet waters vs general waters, agitation producing foam, containment/fixing in the shell, ordained portion) are correspondentially tight.
